Smriti Mandhana Retains Top ODI Batting Ranking

Smriti Mandhana has maintained her position as the world's number one batter in the ICC Women's ODI Player Rankings. Deepti Sharma experienced a decline in her ranking, while Ellyse Perry has re-entered the top 10. Harmanpreet Kaur is ranked ninth.
